part2.question: Describe an experience that you were proud of

segments.v: I want to talk about when my team won first prize at the school science fair last year. It was in the spring, in grade 10. I worked with three classmates and I was the team leader. We made a cheap water filter with sand, stones, charcoal and a plastic bottle. We had this idea because in my grandparents' village, some people have dirty water. We tested the filter in the chemistry lab for many weeks. At first it did not work, but we did not give up and we changed it many times. On the day of the fair, I presented our project to the judges. I was very nervous but I did it. I was very proud because we won and because we worked hard. I was also proud because I am shy but I could speak in front of many people.
